value.rationale: The original resource-survival phase question is a motivated dynamical classification. Uniform fixation lets the whole coupled four-phenotype model be classified globally rather than by numerical absence of recurrent states. At exactly the two originally plotted resource thresholds, the rigorous resource relaxation slows from exponential phenotype fixation to an exact, channel-dependent t^{-1} law; the coefficient is a natural quantitative measure of resource persistence and sensitivity to perception cutoff and noise. The sharp critical-rate fact is not a generic parameter substitution in the source equilibrium table.
